relations.rationale: If Hugo booked the hall, then it is false that he did not book the hall.
Booking a hall has no bearing on relative height between Mina and Hugo.
Booking a hall has no bearing on Leo's height relative to the group.
Leo stretching and chatting near the fence has no bearing on whether someone handed out flyers.
Leo stretching near the fence is consistent with runners later setting off together, but doesn't establish it.

Dara before Leo doesn't by itself establish Dara before Wren without knowing Leo-Wren order.

Arrival order of Dara and Leo has no bearing on cheers rising as the race began.

Temperature of the morning air has no bearing on relative heights of Hugo and Leo.
